name: CRNDose
summary: Dose-response monotonicity analysis for general reaction networks
title: CRNDose
org: Dose-response monotonicity for general mass-action reaction networks
bullets: Aims to generalize the analysis in “Structural constraints on non-monotonic dose response in targeted protein degradation networks” from the degrader network to an arbitrary mass-action reaction network, given a dose and an output species.

Being built to return a steady-state verdict (monotone, monotone under stated conditions, or non-monotonicity permissible) with a machine-checkable certificate; the symbolic steady-state analysis is sound but incomplete, and transients are treated numerically.
Planned stack: Python with SymPy, NumPy/SciPy and Tellurium, with regression tests against the manuscript's results.
notes: DRAFT for the owner's approval. Work in progress: the source document is an implementation spec, so every bullet is worded as design, not result. Named CRNDose by the owner (2026-11-18); the spec's package name is crn_dose/. Start Nov 2026 given by the owner (2026-11-17); end present because it is in progress. Fact-check 2026-11-17: the CoNtRol clause was removed from the bullets because the spec says its list of CoNtRol capabilities is from memory and unverified.
